title: GOD AS ROOT - Long Edition
summary: Long-form source edition arguing the Trinitarian God is the single unprovable Layer-0 axiom paying four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation); physics is the created medium/grammar for love, choice, and grace; ten physical laws compose a portrait matching Christ with agency as the repeated structural gap; the framework inverts 'God of the gaps' by reading God in the completions, names kill conditions in advance, and lays out the Cross-Resolution method, the 24-step Descent, progressive revelation, and the canon reading order.

atoms.name: The Trinity Is the Single Ground Axiom
atoms.statementTechnical: The Trinitarian God (aseity, perichoresis, love) is the one Layer-0 axiom from which existence, distinction, relation, and orientation derive; it is unprovable by design (DG1).
atoms.statementPlain: God is the floor beneath everything; you can't prove Him because a provable axiom would rest on something deeper.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Demonstrate a deeper ground from which the Trinity derives, or show the four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are derivable without it.
atoms.notes: Four debts: existence, distinction, relation, orientation.

atoms.name: Physics Is the Created Medium, Not God
atoms.statementTechnical: Physics is the ordered created medium enabling relation, consequence, choice, time, repair, embodiment, and love to be publicly meaningful; it is not grace and not the Creator.
atoms.statementPlain: Physics is the grammar God speaks so creatures can exist, choose, and be redeemed — not God, not grace.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show a world where love, choice, consequence, and repair are real without any lawful physical medium, or show physics is identical to grace/God.

atoms.name: Ten Laws Compose a Portrait of Christ
atoms.statementTechnical: Measured properties of ten physical structures (gravity, strong force, EM, mass-energy, thermodynamics, information, relativity, QM, weak force, coherence) read together compose a specific personal portrait; agency is the identical missing variable in all ten.
atoms.statementPlain: Read the ten laws together and they describe one Person; the same gap — agency — appears ten times.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Produce a force whose measured properties have no matching spiritual structure, or show the ten mappings are arbitrary/coincidental under adversarial test.

atoms.name: God in the Completions, Not the Gaps
atoms.statementTechnical: The framework reads ten fully explained laws, not unexplained gaps; the more science explains, the clearer the portrait, so it does not bet on science failing.
atoms.statementPlain: God isn't hiding in what we don't know; He's written into what we do know.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show that the portrait depends on scientific ignorance, i.e., that fuller explanation dissolves the structural match.

atoms.name: The Necessary Ground Argument
atoms.statementTechnical: If closed systems decay and the universe persists, an external source must be necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active, and personal; these map to aseity, self-sufficiency, eternality, omnipresence, Logos, providence, personhood.
atoms.statementPlain: The universe needs a source outside itself that is necessary, self-grounding, active, and personal — the God theologians already described.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the universe is a closed system that sustains itself, or that the five required properties are jointly incoherent or unnecessary.

atoms.name: The Descent: 24 Steps to the Cross
atoms.statementTechnical: A 24-step causal chain from God's creation through distinction, information, relation, value, moral valence, agency, decay, adversarial refusal, debt, justice, mercy, and grace converges at Christ.
atoms.statementPlain: Follow being all the way down and you arrive at the Cross.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Identify a step that does not follow, or show the chain can terminate elsewhere without smuggling premises.

atoms.name: Progressive Revelation as Reference-Frame Building
atoms.statementTechnical: God reveals incrementally (slavery, wilderness, Law, prophets, exile) because receivers lack the reference frame to parse the full signal at once.
atoms.statementPlain: God teaches like a teacher: you don't teach calculus to a child who can't count.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show revelation is not progressive or that the reference-frame account adds nothing over arbitrary historical contingency.

atoms.name: The Cross-Resolution Method
atoms.statementTechnical: Every major claim must be read in its proper register (theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, bridge); no register may smuggle in another, and bridges must be marked with strength and limits.
atoms.statementPlain: Test each claim where it belongs; mark the bridges honestly; no hidden upgrades.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the method permits smuggling (e.g., theology rescuing weak physics) or that it cannot be applied consistently.

atoms.name: The Empty Tomb as Physics Claim
atoms.statementTechnical: Resurrection entails two physics claims: information survives destruction of its container, and entropy is locally reversed by coupling to an external source.
atoms.statementPlain: The empty tomb says the pattern outlives the substrate and decay gets reversed from outside.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show information cannot survive substrate destruction in principle, or that no external coupling can locally reverse entropy.

atoms.name: Pre-Human Math
atoms.statementTechnical: E=mc^2 operated for 4.6 billion years before Einstein formulated it.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the equation is observer-dependent or did not hold pre-formulation.

atoms.name: Fine-Tuning of the Cosmological Constant
atoms.statementTechnical: Cosmological constant tuned to 1 part in 10^120.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the tuning is necessary or the figure is wrong.

atoms.name: Hubble Tension
atoms.statementTechnical: Universe expands at two rates depending on measurement; 5-sigma discrepancy.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the discrepancy resolves within standard models without new framework.

atoms.name: Honest Limit / Kill Conditions
atoms.statementTechnical: The match could be coincidence; a skeptic could write the opposite essay; the framework needs science to keep succeeding and the pattern to keep holding.
atoms.falsificationCondition: A force with no matching structure, or collapse of the ten-law pattern under adversarial testing.

atoms.name: Why Does the World Need Physics?
atoms.statementTechnical: If God is sovereign, why gravity, entropy, quantum uncertainty, a running-down universe?
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show physics is unnecessary for creaturely love, choice, and repair.

atoms.name: Why a Tree?
atoms.statementTechnical: The tree is free will made visible; freedom without a real choice is a word.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show a genuine choice is possible without any real alternative.

atoms.name: Why Not Make God Impossible to Miss?
atoms.statementTechnical: The adversary saw God directly and rebelled; proximity never guaranteed loyalty; faith is the proof of love proximity cannot fake.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show that direct sight guarantees loyalty.

atoms.name: What About the Cross?
atoms.statementTechnical: The uncorrupted pattern voluntarily enters the broken system; 'It is finished' is successful deployment; the veil tears top-down.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the cross is defeat rather than the mechanism that ends the adversary.

atoms.name: GOD AS ROOT - Long Edition
atoms.statementTechnical: Preserved long-form source edition; candidate, not canonized.

atoms.name: Canon Reading Order
atoms.statementTechnical: Story first, equations second, gauntlet last; 7Q Classifier is the gauntlet, not the doorway.

atoms.name: Cross-Resolution Status Table
atoms.statementTechnical: Theology strong; lived reality strong; physics modest; bridge declared; mathematics partially formalized.
